rows.en: A base?
You're more than welcome there!
It's not a bad place, you know?
Yes, that's right.
We'll explain the details later!
...I see. So this is where all of you woke up.
Even so... it looks like all sorts of things have been gathered up here.
But most of them no longer work.
Is that so...? Some of it looks usable, though...
What's this...?
Mebius, isn't this an Archive?
You're right! It's the GUYS Archive Document!
What's that?
It's a file of data on kaiju and aliens.
Then it's got data on Seamons and Seagorath too?
Of course, Zero. I'm searching now...
A lot of these files are corrupted... That one was... MAT, if I recall...
Found it!!
Document MAT, Register Code: Tsunami Monster Seamons, Tornado Monster Seagorath...!
Oh!! Alright!!
Is there... some kind of weakness?
It says that when MAT's new weapon broke their horns, they lost their special powers!
That's it!
So their weak spot is the horns...
Alright! Let's go!!
Wait!
Let's split up the roles before we go.
Mebius and I will go ahead and attack their horns.
Once the storm stops, you all use that opening to get in close and hit them hard in one go.
I see. Not bad.
Leave it to us!!
Right, then we'll go on ahead.
Let's go, Mebius!
You made it. Are you ready?
Understood. Mebius and I will stand by here.
Alright, here we go. Ready, Mebius!?
Right!
Seamons! Seagorath!
You're up against us!
Kiiiiigwah!!
Groooooooh!!
Ugh...! What a wind...!
Hold on, Mebius!! Get as close as you can, then hit them with the Mebium Shoot!
Roger!!
Raaaaaaah!!
Now!!
Mebium Shoot!!
Knight Shoot!!
Gyaaaaah!!
Gwaaaaah!!
The two beams shattered Seamons and Seagorath's horns, and the raging storm began to weaken.
...The wind's stopped!
Now!! Go!!
Well done!!
We did it!!
Fufufufu... So you went and beat them, did you?
Bogal!! So you were behind this!!
Ultraman Hikari... Always getting in my way.
You devoured the planet I loved and took everything from me!
It's not enough. I'm still... still, still, still, still not full!!
Maybe I'll eat the whole lot of you, too!!
...Is what I'd like to say! Too bad! I can't eat heroes without Lord Weather's permission.
Lucky you, saved your lives, huh? Fu, fufu, fufufufu...!!
Aaaaaaaaaahahahahahaha!!
Bogal...!! You...!!
Either way, the Central District ahead will be your grave! Ahahaha... aha... ahahahahaaa!!
You won't get away!!
There is a Barabas corpse here.
Past the shutter, there were signs of battle everywhere.
...These have to be marks from an Ultra Warrior's fight!
They've got to be up ahead!
Looks like there was fighting on this side, too. ...The Ultra Warriors Zero mentioned?
Seems someone was fighting in this area too. ...Could it be the Ultra Warriors Zero spoke of?
Someone's been fighting on this side too... Maybe the Ultra Warriors Zero was talking about.
The weather's changed...
The weather changed...? Looks like the Weather Dopant's handiwork.
Whoa, it's freezing...!! It suddenly got so cold...
The weather changed...?
Yo!!
Hey, hey! Hold on!! It's me! Me, me!!

notes.note: 0114 #0.44-0.71 and 0115 #0.1/#0.20 have no recovered speaker; speakers inferred from speech style and address. Ultra lines at the base: Mebius polite (desu/masu), Hikari plain and firm, Zero brash.
Mebius repeats Zero's word 'base' (same term as earlier slices). #0.37-0.40 are party-leader branches answering him.
Shotaro's literal line is just 'Welcome!'; rendered as welcoming them to the base.
Inferred speaker: Mebius (polite, addresses everyone as minasan).
Uncertain speaker: Hikari or a party member (plain 'da na'). #0.46/#0.47 are an unattributed exchange (one says nothing works, another disagrees); kept neutral.
Inferred speaker: Hikari (addresses Mebius, later runs the search).
Inferred speaker: Zero (Hikari answers 'Of course, Zero' to #0.53). #0.51 could also be a party member.
Inferred speaker: Hikari (plain 'mochiron da, Zero'); #0.55-0.57 continue Hikari reading the archive.
GUYS archive formula 'Document MAT, Register Code' kept; kaiju epithets: Seamons = Tsunami Monster, Seagorath = Tornado Monster.
Inferred speaker: Mebius (polite 'arimasu ne').
#0.64-0.67 and #0.70-0.71 inferred as Hikari (plans with 'Mebius and I', 'Let's go, Mebius'). #0.63/#0.68/#0.69 inferred as Zero.
Source drops the subject; rendered 'Leave it to us' since the speaker answers for the team the plan assigned. Could be 'me' if a single hero is meant.
Speaker not recovered; Hikari (he and Mebius went ahead and waited).
Kaiju roars (#0.9, #0.10, #0.18, #0.19) transliterated as sound effects.
Mebium Shoot / Knight Shoot: established English attack names.
Hikari and Mebius after the party beats the kaiju: 'Well done' (Hikari praising the team) and 'We did it' (Mebius). Both could be read as 'You did it'.
Bogal writes 'I/me' in katakana (alien voice); echoed lightly with capitalized 'My'. Glossary g=n, no pronouns used for Bogal.
Source has a kanji meaning 'overturn' where 'love' fits (likely a typo or mis-decode); read as 'the planet I loved' (Bogal devoured Hikari's adopted planet Arb).
Weather-sama rendered 'Lord Weather' (Bogal deferring to the Weather Dopant).
'Central District' = the area name ahead (chuuou chiku); not in glossary.
Examine message (narration).
Number unspecified in source; rendered 'an Ultra Warrior's fight' (Zero suspects his fellow Ultras).
Momotaros's 'ore, ore' kept as 'It's me! Me, me!!'.
proofread: 'You're welcome to it' means 'take it, I don't want it'; source is a plain welcome.
proofread: restored dropped 'if I recall' (Hikari is remembering which file it was).
proofread: capitalised 'My' dropped; later slices voice Bogal's katakana 'I' as plain 'I'/'my'.

report: 80/80 rows. Many 0114 base-scene speakers unlabelled and inferred (Mebius/Hikari/Zero by speech style). 0115 #0.28 read a likely mis-encoded kanji as 'loved'. Names not in glossary: GUYS, MAT, Mebium Shoot, Knight Shoot, Central District, Lord Weather (form of address).
